components.label: Samson GoMic
components.explanation: Samson GoMic USB condenser microphone kept awake via keepMicrophoneReady in WirePlumber so the first spoken syllable is never clipped.

components.label: Manual Hotkey
components.explanation: Global Hyprland shortcut to manually start or stop Superwhisper recording when hands-free VAD is paused.

components.label: Adaptive VAD Thread
components.explanation: Continuously computes 100ms RMS energy and rolling median room noise floor (~950 RMS). Starts recording at >=2200 RMS and stops after 0.85s of silence.

components.label: Live OSD Meter
components.explanation: Displays real-time audio level bars and countdown timer while speaking, plus command confirmation alerts.

components.label: Superwhisper Service
components.explanation: Systemd user daemon that captures microphone audio and coordinates transcription without blindly auto-pasting into focused apps.

components.label: Superwhisper Cloud
components.explanation: Cloud speech-to-text and LLM formatting engine (~1.0s turnaround) keeping local RAM usage under 2 MB on the i5-4260U.

components.label: Recordings Store
components.explanation: Local directory where Superwhisper writes completed transcription metadata and text results.

components.label: Voice Commander Router
components.explanation: Watches meta.json completions, splits compound utterances on wake words (Computer/Assistant/Omarchy), strips polite phrases, and routes intents.

components.label: Config & State Store
components.explanation: Stores wake words, VAD thresholds, app mappings, websites, terminal shortcuts, and active mode (Hybrid, Command, Dictation).

components.label: App & WM Executor
components.explanation: Launches desktop apps (Terminal, Chromium, Nautilus, Editor), switches workspaces 1-10, toggles fullscreen, and adjusts volume/brightness.

components.label: Browser Personal Agent
components.explanation: Automates web navigation ('take me to...'), YouTube/GitHub search, tab switching, and link clicking by text via Ctrl+F -> text -> Escape -> Enter.

components.label: Key & Text Injector
components.explanation: Types dictated sentences into focused apps (Herdr/Antigravity), executes smart terminal commands with Enter, and sends key chords.

cards.title: 1. Adaptive Audio & VAD
items: Samson GoMic kept ready via WirePlumber hook
Rolling median noise floor (~950 RMS) prevents 25s hangs
Auto-stops 0.85s after speech ends with live OSD meter

cards.title: 2. Multi-Command Router
items: Splits compound sentences on wake words (Computer / Assistant)
Strips polite phrasing ('Can you please...') and deduplicates
Never leaks wake-word commands into active text boxes

cards.title: 3. Personal Desktop & Browser Agent
items: Clicks webpage links by name via Ctrl+F Quick-Find sequence
Launches Omarchy apps, switches Hyprland workspaces 1-10
Executes terminal commands or types dictation via wtype
